label: Голова
description: A 10-sentence usage card for голова in full everyday sentences across health, position, and case usage.

missions.phrase: После работы у меня болит голова.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Basic health statement. 1. 'Голова' is the body noun in the nominative as subject of 'болит'. 2. 'У меня' frames whose symptom it is. 3. Standard way to report a headache.

missions.phrase: Сегодня утром у меня сильно болит голова.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Possession plus condition. 1. 'У меня' marks the experiencer naturally. 2. 'Голова' stays nominative subject. 3. The standard Russian construction for reporting a headache.

missions.phrase: Он медленно поднял голову и улыбнулся.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion of the head. 1. 'Голову' appears in the accusative as direct object of 'поднял'. 2. 'Поднял' is a practical past action. 3. Very common in narrative.

missions.phrase: Мальчик уважительно склонил голову перед учителем.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Simple body motion. 1. 'Голову' is accusative, the direct object of 'склонил'. 2. 'Склонить голову' is a natural expression. 3. Good for physical description and story language.

missions.phrase: На голове у неё была тёплая шапка.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Location on the body. 1. 'На голове' uses the prepositional case for placement. 2. 'Шапка' is a useful everyday noun. 3. A vivid, simple household sentence.

missions.phrase: Над головой ярко горел уличный свет.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Spatial relation above. 1. 'Над головой' is an instrumental prepositional phrase meaning 'overhead'. 2. 'Свет' makes the scene concrete. 3. Useful for environment descriptions.

missions.phrase: Я задумчиво чешу голову над задачей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direct action on the body. 1. 'Голову' is accusative, the object of 'чешу'. 2. 'Чешу' is a simple first-person verb. 3. Natural and easy to type.

missions.phrase: В голове у меня вертится одна идея.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Abstract content in the head. 1. 'В голове' uses the prepositional case, a very common phrase. 2. 'Идея' links body and thought. 3. Useful for everyday metaphor.

missions.phrase: У этого ребёнка очень большая голова.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Adjective agreement. 1. 'Большая' agrees with the feminine nominative 'голова'. 2. The phrase is direct and easy to picture. 3. A clean adjective+noun training line.

missions.phrase: Она всегда идёт с высоко поднятой головой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental descriptive phrase. 1. 'Головой' is instrumental in 'с поднятой головой'. 2. The sentence adds attitude and posture. 3. Bridges body nouns and expressive language.
